_method_version: 1.0.0 promotes seven figures from a workspace recipe. Two changes for promotion, both verified: openpyxl replaced with a stdlib xlsx reader, checked cell by cell against openpyxl on the ONS workbook (89 rows, no disagreement) and the downstream rank correlation reproduced at +0.79; and seven scripts that hardcoded ../data were made to honour FSB_DATA, without which the recipe only ran from one directory. Every figure was confirmed byte-identical across two separate builds.
sources_note: Companies House publishes a live-register snapshot: in the first 73,146 rows the count carrying a DissolutionDate is ZERO, and every status present is one a company holds while still registered. The register publishes survivors and drops its dead. What makes survival measurable is that the publisher keeps a back-catalogue at dated URLs that nothing links to, so three snapshots a year apart give a death definition the register itself does not provide: a company is dead when it stops appearing.
